author: Bijan Mousavi

checks.command: git diff --cached --exit-code HEAD -- src public package-lock.json astro.config.mjs netlify.toml tsconfig.json Dockerfile helm-chart .github .dockerignore

title: Discoverable developer command interface
why: Give contributors consistent commands and safe cleanup without duplicating application behavior or silently provisioning tools.
what: Add thin Make targets and npm aliases, guarded setup, output-only cleanup and command failure tests. Report tests reject empty collection.
how: Make delegates to npm. Keep setup outside npm lifecycle names. Test exit-seven propagation, nonmutating help, cleanup boundaries and original application scripts on an exported index.
preserved: Original dev/start/build/preview/local/prod scripts, application bytes, lock, adapters, assets, deployment and inherited CI are unchanged. Clean preserves user files and artifacts.
risk: Make and Python are explicit prerequisites. Cleanup assumes untracked allowlisted build directories are generated outputs; tracked paths and symlinks are rejected.
limitations: 13 developer tests, 57 report tests and clean locked setup passed with Node 24.21.0/npm 11.19.0 on macOS arm64. No new browser, deployment or remote CI result; audit debt remains.
rollback: Revert wrappers, new command scripts and their guide together in a reported commit. Existing application npm interfaces continue to work.
